{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
has_paid_search = 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique()
has_new_customers = 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check if there are NEW customers in PAID_SEARCH
new_paid_search = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

print("Premise 1: PAID SEARCH is in data:", has_paid_search)
print("Premise 2: NEW segment exists:", has_new_customers)
print("Number of NEW customers in PAID_SEARCH:", len(new_paid_search))

# Check if any of these have converted
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)

print("Converted count:", converted_count)
print("Total count:", total_count)

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count
print("Fraction converted:", fraction_converted)"}
